_about: Hugh Latimer (c.1487-1555), Bishop of Worcester. The target is the Parker Society edition, ed. George Elwes Corrie (2 vols, Cambridge 1844-1845), Internet Archive OCR, raw; each title page read. Clean text alongside: CCEL's Sermons, and Henry Morley's 1883 selection from Gutenberg (PG header checked, no COPYRIGHTED marker). CCEL's Sermons by Hugh Latimer (latimer-sermons-ccel) states no print source and no rights line, so its editorial matter cannot be dated; the sermons themselves are 16th-century. Noted 2026-10-03 for a look before republishing.
